results.title: Son of Myanmar's Suu Kyi 'relieved' by first call in five years, questions military's motives

results.title: NATO deploys AWACS airborne radar to monitor Polish airspace
results.content: NATO has authorised deploying an AWACS reconnaissance aircraft to Poland after prosecutors said three Russian cruise missiles fell on its territory. The flying radar has served since the Cold War, in the Balkans, in Libya and after 11 September over US airspace.

results.title: Argentina enters technical recession as weak consumption undermines Milei's economic gains
